steps.title: Open Tapeology
steps.narration: Open Tapeology and you land on a clean cockpit that is waiting for a ticker. Nothing is invented yet — until you choose something to watch, it honestly says there is no ticker.
steps.point_out: The centered "No ticker watched" prompt with the "Try: SIM-BUYER" hint, and the footer line reminding you this is descriptive only — not trading advice.

steps.title: Enter a ticker
steps.narration: Type SIM-BUYER into the ticker box — the built-in scenario we will read live off the tape.
steps.point_out: The ticker box now reads SIM-BUYER, ready to watch.

steps.title: Watch the live tape
steps.narration: Click Watch and the whole cockpit comes alive — six panels fill at once with real, live numbers streaming straight from the engine.
steps.point_out: Quote (bid, ask, spread, last), Recent Trades, Features, Tape State, Observations, and the Event Log all populate together — no spinner, no placeholder dashes.

steps.title: The tape reads Buyer Control
steps.narration: Give it a moment and the tape resolves to Buyer Control at high confidence. Notice the numbers climbed on their own — no page reload — arriving continuously over the live stream.
steps.point_out: Tape State reads "Buyer Control" with the confidence bar nearly full; the Features panel shows a high aggressive-buy ratio and a positive buy price impact (genuine control, not just noise); the Event Log records "Tape state changed to buyer_control".

steps.title: One source of truth
steps.narration: Every number on screen is read straight from the engine — open the same ticker's data endpoint and the state, confidence, and features match exactly. There is never a second, disagreeing copy.
steps.point_out: The on-screen tape state, confidence, and feature values mirror the API readings for SIM-BUYER one for one.

steps.title: Try an unknown ticker
steps.narration: Now the honesty test: type NOPE_UNKNOWN, a ticker that does not exist, and try to watch it.
steps.point_out: The ticker box now reads NOPE_UNKNOWN.

steps.title: Honest about bad input
steps.narration: Tapeology refuses to fake it. An unknown ticker gets a clear message and the cockpit stays calm — no crash, no blank screen, and crucially no made-up tape.
steps.point_out: A red message under the top bar explains the ticker is not known; the idle prompt returns and you can immediately try a valid ticker again.
